words.definition: adv. 然而；尽管如此

examples.en: The task was demanding; nevertheless, she completed it on time.
examples.zh: 任务艰巨；尽管如此，她仍按时完成了。

examples.en: Profits fell sharply last quarter. Nevertheless, the company refused to cut staff.
examples.zh: 上季度利润骤降。尽管如此，公司仍拒绝裁员。

words.usage: 正式书面转折词，常置于句首或句中，用分号或句号与前文隔开；语义强于 however，与 nonetheless 基本等同。阅读中标志「让步＋转折」结构，作者态度常在其后。
collocations: but nevertheless 但尽管如此
nevertheless, it remains true 尽管如此，这仍然成立
slow progress; nevertheless steady 进展缓慢，但稳步向前
words.mnemonic: never(绝不)+the+less(少)→即便如此也绝不减少→然而

words.definition: n. 协议；礼仪；规程

examples.en: The two sides signed a protocol on cross-border environmental cooperation.
examples.zh: 双方签署了一项跨境环保合作议定书。

examples.en: Laboratory staff must follow strict safety protocols at all times.
examples.zh: 实验室人员必须始终遵守严格的安全规程。

words.usage: 科技语境指通信协议；外交语境指礼节；实验语境指安全规程。常考 follow／break a protocol 遵守／违反规程。可数名词，复数 protocols。
collocations: network protocol 网络协议
follow safety protocols 遵守安全规程
diplomatic protocol 外交礼节
words.mnemonic: proto(首要)+col(胶)→首份粘好的公文→议定书→礼节

words.definition: n. 提议，主张；命题；棘手的事

examples.en: The board rejected the takeover proposition without hesitation.
examples.zh: 董事会毫不犹豫地否决了这项收购提议。

examples.en: Starting a business during a recession is a risky proposition.
examples.zh: 在经济衰退期创业是件冒险的事。

words.usage: 逻辑学指命题；商业语境 a risky／attractive proposition 指有风险／有吸引力的事，属熟词僻义。区别 proposal（正式建议书）与本词（提出的主张）。

confusables.note: 介词，e 替代 o 易混

collocations: a risky proposition 有风险的事
make a proposition 提出主张
value proposition 价值主张
words.mnemonic: pro(向前)+pos(放)+ition→放到桌面上→提议；命题

words.definition: adj. 获利丰厚的；有利可图的

examples.en: Catering to wealthy tourists has become a lucrative business on the island.
examples.zh: 迎合富裕游客的生意在这座岛上利润丰厚。

examples.en: He gave up a lucrative career in finance to teach in a remote village.
examples.zh: 他放弃了金融业的高薪职业，去偏远村庄任教。

words.usage: 多作定语修饰 business，market，contract，career，强调报酬丰厚、有利可图；近义 profitable 侧重已实际获利。派生：lucratively adv. 获利丰厚地。
collocations: a lucrative business 利润丰厚的生意
a lucrative contract 报酬丰厚的合同
a lucrative market 有利可图的市场
words.mnemonic: lucr(钱，同 lucre)+ative→多钱的→有利可图

words.definition: adj. 深刻的，深远的；渊博的；深厚的

examples.en: The invention of the internet had a profound impact on global commerce.
examples.zh: 互联网的发明对全球商业产生了深远影响。

examples.en: The book offers profound insights into consumer behavior.
examples.zh: 这本书对消费行为提出了深刻的洞见。

words.usage: 常考搭配 profound impact／influence 深远影响，profound changes 深刻变革；亦形容思想、知识渊博深刻。派生：profoundly adv. 深深地。
collocations: profound impact 深远影响
profound changes 深刻变革
profound insight 深刻的洞察
words.mnemonic: pro(向前)+found(底)→一路探到底→深刻的

words.definition: adj. 著名的；显眼的；突出的

examples.en: A prominent scientist warned that the study lacked peer review.
examples.zh: 一位知名科学家警告说，这项研究缺乏同行评审。

examples.en: The new library occupies a prominent position at the heart of the campus.
examples.zh: 新图书馆位于校园中心，位置十分显眼。

words.usage: 形容人：a prominent figure 知名人物；形容物：a prominent position 显眼位置。派生：prominence n. 突出；著名（come to prominence 崭露头角）。

confusables.note: 占主导的，多 de- 音节

collocations: a prominent figure 知名人物
a prominent role 重要作用
a prominent position 显要位置
words.mnemonic: pro(前)+min(伸出)+ent→向前伸出→显眼的

words.definition: adj. 有弹性的；适应力强的

examples.en: Local businesses proved resilient to the economic downturn.
examples.zh: 当地企业在经济衰退中表现出较强的抗风险能力。

examples.en: Rubber is a resilient material that springs back to its original shape.
examples.zh: 橡胶是一种能弹回原状的有弹性材料。

words.usage: 常考 be resilient to sth 对…有适应力，以及 prove／remain resilient；多形容经济、生态与儿童的抗冲击恢复力。派生：resilience n. 韧性，考研阅读高频。
collocations: resilient economy 有韧性的经济
be resilient to shocks 抗冲击
resilient materials 弹性材料
words.mnemonic: re(回)+sili(跳)+ent→能跳回来的→有弹性的

words.definition: vi. 诉诸，求助；n. 度假村；手段

examples.en: When negotiations failed, the union resorted to strike action.
examples.zh: 谈判失败后，工会诉诸了罢工行动。

examples.en: The fishing village has grown into a popular tourist resort.
examples.zh: 这个小渔村已发展成热门旅游度假地。

words.usage: resort to sth／to doing 诉诸某手段，含被迫无奈义，考研高频；as a last resort 作为最后手段；名词另指度假村（a ski resort）。注意此处 to 为介词，后接动名词。
collocations: resort to violence 诉诸暴力
a tourist resort 旅游度假村
as a last resort 作为最后手段
words.mnemonic: re(回)+sort(去)→回头再去找的办法→手段；诉诸

words.definition: vt. 剥削；开发利用；n. 功绩（复数）

examples.en: The firm was accused of exploiting cheap labor in developing countries.
examples.zh: 该公司被指剥削发展中国家的廉价劳动力。

examples.en: New technologies make it possible to exploit solar energy on a large scale.
examples.zh: 新技术使大规模利用太阳能成为可能。

words.usage: exploit resources／labor 开发资源、剥削劳动力；exploit opportunities 抓住机会。派生：exploitation n. 剥削；overexploitation 过度开采。
collocations: exploit natural resources 开发自然资源
exploit cheap labor 剥削廉价劳动力
exploit an opportunity 利用机会
words.mnemonic: ex(出)+ploit(折，同 ply)→折出来用→开发利用

words.definition: n. 预订；保留意见；（印第安人）居留地

examples.en: I would like to make a reservation for two nights in the name of Smith.
examples.zh: 我想以史密斯的名义预订两晚的房间。

examples.en: Lawmakers voiced reservations about the safety of the new drug.
examples.zh: 议员们对这种新药的安全性表达了保留意见。

words.usage: make a reservation 预订；have／voice reservations about 对…心存疑虑；without reservation 毫无保留。名词另指美洲原住民保留地，熟词僻义。
collocations: make a reservation 预订
express reservations about 对…表示保留
without reservation 毫无保留
words.mnemonic: re(回)+serv(保存)+ation→先存着→预订；保留

words.definition: vt. 预订；保留；n. 储备；自然保护区

examples.en: These seats are reserved for elderly and disabled passengers.
examples.zh: 这些座位是为老年和残障乘客预留的。

examples.en: The central bank dipped into its foreign reserves to defend the currency.
examples.zh: 央行动用外汇储备来捍卫本国货币。

words.usage: reserve seats 预订座位；in reserve 备用；nature reserve 自然保护区；foreign reserves 外汇储备。派生：reserved adj. 矜持的。
collocations: reserve a table 订餐位
foreign currency reserves 外汇储备
nature reserve 自然保护区
words.mnemonic: re(回)+serv(保存)→留存备用→预订；储备

words.definition: vt. 使惊讶；使震惊

examples.en: The survey results astonished even the most seasoned analysts.
examples.zh: 调查结果连最资深的分析师也大为惊讶。

examples.en: It astonished the committee that no one had checked the data.
examples.zh: 令委员会吃惊的是，竟没有人核对过这些数据。

words.usage: 及物动词，宾语多为人：sth astonishes sb；It astonishes sb that… 常考句型。派生：astonishing adj. 令人惊讶的；in astonishment 惊讶地。
collocations: be astonished at 对…感到惊讶
in astonishment 惊讶地
an astonishing discovery 惊人的发现
words.mnemonic: 词源 ex＋tonare(打雷)→如遭雷击→大为惊讶

words.definition: n. 连续；继任；一连串

examples.en: He was appointed chairman in succession to Mr. Brown.
examples.zh: 他被任命接替布朗先生出任主席。

examples.en: The team suffered a succession of defeats throughout the season.
examples.zh: 该队整个赛季接连失利。

words.usage: in succession to 接替；a succession of 一连串；in quick succession 紧接着。派生：successive adj. 连续的；successor n. 继任者。
collocations: a succession of 一连串的
in succession 接连地
in succession to 接替
words.mnemonic: suc(下面)+cess(走)→从下面跟上→继承；接连

words.definition: vt. 延长；拖延

examples.en: The treatment can prolong the patient's life by several years.
examples.zh: 这种治疗能使病人的生命延长数年。

examples.en: Neither side wished to prolong the negotiations unnecessarily.
examples.zh: 双方都不愿不必要地拖延谈判。

words.usage: prolong life／pain 延长寿命、痛苦；区别 extend 延长期限与 lengthen 加长长度。派生：prolonged adj. 持久的，a prolonged drought 久旱。
collocations: prolong one's life 延长寿命
a prolonged drought 长期干旱
prolong the negotiations 拖长谈判
words.mnemonic: pro(向前)+long(长)→向前拉长→延长

words.definition: adj. 肤浅的；表面的；（伤）轻微的

examples.en: The article offers only a superficial analysis of the housing crisis.
examples.zh: 这篇文章对住房危机的分析只是浮于表面。

examples.en: He escaped with only superficial cuts and bruises.
examples.zh: 他只受了些轻微的皮外伤便得以脱身。

words.usage: superficial knowledge 肤浅的知识；superficial wounds 表皮伤；含贬义，指浮于表面。派生：superficiality n. 浅薄。词根 super 上＋fic 面。
collocations: superficial knowledge 肤浅的知识
a superficial glance 匆匆一瞥
superficial wounds 表皮外伤
words.mnemonic: super(上面)+fic(面)+ial→浮于表面→肤浅的

words.definition: vt. 促进；晋升；宣传

examples.en: The government introduced tax breaks to promote small business growth.
examples.zh: 政府推出税收优惠以促进小企业发展。

examples.en: She was promoted to senior manager after only two years.
examples.zh: 她仅用两年就被提拔为高级经理。

words.usage: promote economic growth 促进增长；promote sb to sth 提升某人为；亦指宣传推销产品。派生：promotion n. 晋升；促销；promoter n. 倡导者。

confusables.note: 促使，词尾 mpt 不同

collocations: promote economic growth 促进经济增长
be promoted to 被提升为
promote a product 推销产品
words.mnemonic: pro(向前)+mote(动，同 motion)→使向前动→促进

words.definition: adj. 多余的；过剩的；累赘的

examples.en: Cutting superfluous staff costs helped the airline survive the crisis.
examples.zh: 削减多余的人事开支帮助这家航空公司渡过了危机。

examples.en: Delete superfluous words to make the essay more concise.
examples.zh: 删掉多余的字眼，让文章更简洁。

words.usage: 多作定语：superfluous words／staff 冗余字句、多余人员；superfluous to requirements 不再需要。派生：superfluity n. 过剩；近义 redundant 冗余的。
collocations: superfluous words 冗余的字句
superfluous staff 多余的人员
cut superfluous expenses 削减多余开支
words.mnemonic: super(超)+flu(流)+ous→流得太多→多余的

words.definition: n. 自杀；自取灭亡

examples.en: Critics argued that the merger amounted to financial suicide for the firm.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为，这次并购对该公司无异于财务自杀。

examples.en: The report links rising debt levels to a higher risk of suicide among young people.
examples.zh: 报告指出，债务攀升与年轻人自杀风险升高相关。

words.usage: commit suicide 自杀为固定搭配；attempted suicide 自杀未遂；suicide rate 自杀率；比喻义指自毁前程。派生：suicidal adj. 自杀性的。
collocations: commit suicide 自杀
suicide rate 自杀率
attempt suicide 企图自杀
words.mnemonic: sui(自己)+cid(切)+e→切自己→自杀

words.definition: adj. 各自的；分别的

examples.en: The two ministers returned to their respective countries after the summit.
examples.zh: 峰会结束后，两位部长各自回国。

examples.en: The twins excel in their respective fields of science and art.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎分别在科学和艺术领域出类拔萃。

words.usage: 只作定语：their respective views 各自的观点；与 respectively adv.「分别地」配套，学术句「A and B，respectively」高频。词根 spect 看，各看各的。
collocations: respective fields 各自的领域
their respective roles 他们各自的角色
in their respective countries 在各自国家
words.mnemonic: re(回)+spect(看)+ive→各回各看→各自的

words.definition: adj. 可理解的；清晰易懂的

examples.en: The professor's lecture was intelligible even to first-year students.
examples.zh: 教授的讲座连大一学生也能听懂。

examples.en: Jargon should be translated into intelligible language for the public.
examples.zh: 行话应转化为公众能听懂的语言。

words.usage: 常与 barely／scarcely 连用：barely intelligible 几乎听不懂；make sth intelligible to sb 使…可被理解。派生：intelligibility n. 可懂度。
collocations: barely intelligible 几乎听不懂
an intelligible explanation 清楚易懂的解释
mutually intelligible 互相能听懂
words.mnemonic: intellig(理解，同 intellect)+ible→能被懂→可理解
